_doc: 小朋友鎮的節慶活動（P4 D）。依台北日期（Asia/Taipei）自動換裝飾＋限定英文活動；不在 dates 範圍內就什麼都不顯示。dates＝[開始, 結束]（含兩端，YYYY-MM-DD）；day＝節日當天（農曆節日照行政院人事行政總處辦公日曆表／農民曆，2027 春節是 2/6，Chrome 內建的農曆算成 2/7 是錯的）。表只寫到 2028 年，2029 起要補。測試模式（?test=1）可以用 &fest=halloween|christmas|lunarnewyear|midautumn|none 預覽。qs：每題 opts 第一個是對的。每回 n 題，照生活任務規則：每題答對 1 金幣、全對再 +1、算每日英文。英文全部原創。

halloween.hello: Happy Halloween! Answer my four Halloween questions, and you will get a treat!
halloween.helloZh: 萬聖節快樂！回答我的四個萬聖節問題，就有糖果可以拿！
halloween.thanks: Great job! Here is your treat. Happy Halloween!
halloween.thanksZh: 做得好！這是給你的糖果。萬聖節快樂！

qs.q: Kids knock on the door on Halloween night. What do they say?
qs.zh: 萬聖節晚上小朋友敲門，他們會說什麼？

qs.q: What do we use to make a jack-o'-lantern?
qs.zh: 南瓜燈是用什麼做的？

qs.q: Mia is wearing a tall black hat and holding a broom. What is she?
qs.zh: 米亞戴著高高的黑帽子、拿著掃把，她扮成什麼？

qs.q: A neighbor gives you some candy. What do you say?
qs.zh: 鄰居給你糖果，你要說什麼？

qs.q: Which animal can fly at night?
qs.zh: 哪一種動物晚上會飛？

qs.q: When is Halloween?
qs.zh: 萬聖節是哪一天？

qs.q: Leo is wearing a white sheet with two holes for his eyes. What is he?
qs.zh: 里歐披著一塊白布，上面有兩個洞給眼睛看，他扮成什麼？

qs.q: The old house is dark and a little scary. What do you say to your friend?
qs.zh: 老房子黑黑的、有點可怕，你要跟朋友說什麼？
opts: Let's go together. Don't be afraid.

qs.q: Ben has three pieces of candy. Amy gives him two more. How many does he have now?
qs.zh: 小班有三顆糖，艾咪又給他兩顆，他現在有幾顆？
opts: He has five pieces of candy.
He has one piece of candy.
He has ten pieces of candy.

qs.q: Which sentence is about a Halloween costume?
qs.zh: 哪一句在說萬聖節的裝扮？
opts: I'm dressing up as a pirate tonight.
I'm riding my bike to school.

christmas.hello: Merry Christmas! Can you answer my four Christmas questions?
christmas.helloZh: 聖誕快樂！你可以回答我的四個聖誕節問題嗎？
christmas.thanks: Wonderful! You get a little present. Merry Christmas!
christmas.thanksZh: 太棒了！送你一個小禮物。聖誕快樂！

qs.q: It's December twenty-fifth. What do people say?
qs.zh: 今天是十二月二十五日，大家會說什麼？

qs.q: Who wears a red suit and brings presents?
qs.zh: 誰穿紅衣服、會送禮物？

qs.q: What do we put on top of the Christmas tree?
qs.zh: 聖誕樹最上面要放什麼？

qs.q: Grandma gives you a present. What do you say?
qs.zh: 奶奶送你禮物，你要說什麼？
opts: Thank you, Grandma! I love it.

qs.q: What is white and cold and falls from the sky in winter?
qs.zh: 冬天從天上掉下來、白白冷冷的是什麼？

qs.q: What can you build with a lot of snow?
qs.zh: 很多雪可以堆什麼？

qs.q: Which animals pull Santa's sleigh?
qs.zh: 誰幫聖誕老公公拉雪橇？

qs.q: What season is Christmas in?
qs.zh: 聖誕節在什麼季節？

qs.q: You write a Christmas card to your friend. Which one is right?
qs.zh: 你寫聖誕卡給朋友，哪一句最合適？
opts: Merry Christmas, Amy! You are a great friend.

qs.q: There is a box with a bow under the tree. What is it?
qs.zh: 聖誕樹下有一個綁著蝴蝶結的盒子，那是什麼？

lunarnewyear.hello: Happy Lunar New Year! Answer my four New Year questions and get a red envelope!
lunarnewyear.helloZh: 新年快樂！回答我的四個新年問題，就有紅包可以拿！
lunarnewyear.thanks: Great job! Here is a red envelope for you. Happy New Year!
lunarnewyear.thanksZh: 做得好！這個紅包給你。新年快樂！

qs.q: It's Lunar New Year. What do people say to each other?
qs.zh: 農曆新年到了，大家互相說什麼？

qs.q: What do kids get inside red envelopes?
qs.zh: 小朋友的紅包裡面有什麼？

qs.q: What do families do on Lunar New Year's Eve?
qs.zh: 除夕晚上一家人會做什麼？
opts: They have a big dinner together.

qs.q: Grandpa gives you a red envelope. What do you say?
qs.zh: 爺爺給你紅包，你要說什麼？
opts: Thank you, Grandpa! Happy New Year!

qs.q: Which color is a lucky color for the New Year?
qs.zh: 過年的時候哪個顏色代表好運？

qs.q: What do people put on their front doors for the New Year?
qs.zh: 過年的時候大家會在門上貼什麼？

qs.q: Boom! Boom! You see bright colors in the night sky. What are they?
qs.zh: 砰！砰！晚上的天空出現亮亮的顏色，那是什麼？

qs.q: Which animal is in the Chinese zodiac?
qs.zh: 哪一種動物是十二生肖之一？

qs.q: What do many families eat for Lunar New Year?
qs.zh: 很多家庭過年會吃什麼？

qs.q: Before the New Year, what do families do at home?
qs.zh: 過年前，一家人會在家裡做什麼？

midautumn.hello: Happy Moon Festival! Look at the big moon. Can you answer my four questions?
midautumn.helloZh: 中秋節快樂！看那個大月亮。你可以回答我的四個問題嗎？
midautumn.thanks: Wonderful! Here is a mooncake for you. Happy Moon Festival!
midautumn.thanksZh: 太棒了！這個月餅給你。中秋節快樂！

qs.q: What do people eat at the Moon Festival?
qs.zh: 中秋節大家會吃什麼？

qs.q: What is big and round in the sky tonight?
qs.zh: 今天晚上天上又大又圓的是什麼？

qs.q: What do many families in Taiwan do on Moon Festival night?
qs.zh: 很多台灣家庭中秋節晚上會做什麼？
opts: They go swimming in the snow.

qs.q: Which fruit do people often eat at the Moon Festival?
qs.zh: 中秋節常吃哪一種水果？

qs.q: In the old story, who lives on the moon?
qs.zh: 在古老的故事裡，誰住在月亮上？

qs.q: Look at the moon! What do you say?
qs.zh: 看月亮！你會說什麼？
opts: Wow, it's so bright and round!
Wow, it's so cold and wet!

qs.q: When is the Moon Festival?
qs.zh: 中秋節是哪一天？
opts: It's on the fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month.

qs.q: Grandma gives you a mooncake. What do you say?
qs.zh: 奶奶給你一個月餅，你要說什麼？
opts: Thank you, Grandma. It looks delicious!

qs.q: What do families do together at night?
qs.zh: 晚上一家人會一起做什麼？
opts: They look at the moon together.
They wash the car in the rain.

qs.q: There are two boxes. Each box has four mooncakes. How many mooncakes are there?
qs.zh: 有兩盒，每盒有四個月餅，總共有幾個月餅？
